description:
Cognition GameJam 2026

Navi Mumbai's Biggest GameJam

**Cognition GameJam 2026**, organized by the Technical Team of SIESGST, is a multi-round game development hackathon designed to challenge participants to build, innovate, and adapt under real-world development constraints.

Whether you are a solo developer or part of a team, the GameJam provides an opportunity to transform ideas into playable experiences while demonstrating your skills in game development, design, programming, problem-solving, and creative thinking.

Participants will begin by developing and submitting a playable prototype. Shortlisted teams will then advance to the final round, where a surprise theme or twist will be revealed. Teams will be required to adapt their existing game and develop a compelling final experience within the given constraints.

## GameJam Structure

###  🔸Round 1 — Prototype Submission

Participants will develop and submit a playable game prototype demonstrating the core concept and fundamental gameplay experience.

The prototype will be evaluated based on:

* Functionality
* Gameplay and game mechanics
* Technical implementation
* Overall execution

**Prototype Submission Deadline:** 17 September 2026

###  🔸Round 2 — Finals & Showcase

Shortlisted teams will compete in the on-campus final round.

A surprise theme or twist will be revealed at the beginning of the final stage. Teams will then adapt and enhance their prototype to incorporate the given challenge within the allotted time.

The final submission will be evaluated based on:

* Creativity
* Innovation
* Execution
* Gameplay experience
* Technical implementation
* Adaptability to the given theme/twist

**Theme Reveal:** 19 September 2026
**Finals & Showcase:** 26 September 2026

## Who Can Participate?

* Open to all participants
* Solo participants are welcome
* Teams of **1–4 members**
* No registration fee
* Online screening round
* On-campus final round

Participants may use their preferred game development tools and technologies, subject to the GameJam rules and guidelines.

## 🎓Why Participate?

Cognition GameJam 2026 offers participants an opportunity to:

* Build a complete playable game under time constraints
* Strengthen practical game development and problem-solving skills
* Receive feedback and evaluation from industry professionals and gaming experts
* Collaborate and network with developers, designers, artists, and gaming enthusiasts
* Build a strong project for their portfolio
* Explore potential internship and industry opportunities

## 🎁Prizes & Opportunities

The GameJam features a **prize pool of ₹10,000** along with recognition for outstanding projects.

Participants may also have access to:

* Mentorship from experienced developers and industry professionals
* Exclusive event merchandise and goodies
* Networking opportunities
* Potential internship opportunities for top-performing teams

## 📢Community & Updates

Participants are encouraged to join the official GameJam community and follow the event's social media channels for announcements, submission guidelines, and other important updates.

 **Discord:** [Join Now](https://discord.gg/TSFnmbYqJ8/)
 **Instagram:** [Follow Us](https://www.instagram.com/technicalteam_siesgst/)
 **LinkedIn:** [Connect Here](https://www.linkedin.com/company/technical-team-sies-gst/)
 **Twitter (X):** [Follow Us](https://x.com/techteam_sies/)


## Contact

For queries regarding the GameJam:

**Ishan Mishra**
[+91 93240 23627](https://wa.me/+919324023627)

**Subhronil Chattoraj**
[+91 8779340742](https://wa.me/+918779340742)

## Ready to Build?

Bring your ideas, form your team, and build something worth playing.

**Your idea. Your game. Your challenge.**

Please ensure that you read and follow the **Code of Conduct** and all official GameJam rules before participating.
